About

A fan game made by one developer

Into the Backrooms VR is a solo developed fan game that brings Gorilla Tag style movement into the Backrooms. The focus is tight physics movement and atmosphere over cheap jump scares, running natively on Quest hardware with optimized lighting.

Development updates are posted regularly. Join the community to follow progress and get into playtests early.

Legal

Into the Backrooms VR Privacy Policy

Last updated June 12, 2025

Overview

Into the Backrooms VR is an independent fan game. This policy explains what information the game collects, why it is collected, and how you can delete it.

What data we collect

The following data is collected privately and is never shown publicly:

  • IP address
  • Player username
  • Player region or country
  • PlayFab Player ID

Why we collect this data

  • To enable multiplayer services such as lobbies, matchmaking, and saved progress.
  • To enforce bans and prevent cheating, abuse, and harassment.

We collect nothing beyond what is listed above. The game does not collect your real name, email address, contacts, or payment details. All purchases are processed entirely by Meta.

How to delete your data

Deleting your data is permanent and cannot be undone. This will erase your progress and unlocks.

  1. Open Settings on your headset
  2. Go to Storage
  3. Find and select Into the Backrooms VR
  4. Tap Delete App Data

If you would like your server side data removed as well, contact us at the email below and we will delete it.

Data sharing and security

We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising or any other purpose. Your information is only sent to the trusted backend services the game needs to function:

  • Photon, for real time multiplayer networking.
  • PlayFab, a Microsoft service, for player accounts and ban enforcement.

Both services maintain their own secure data protection systems and process data under their own privacy policies.

Your rights

  • Your information is used only for the purposes listed in this policy.
  • You may request a copy or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

Purchases

All purchases are final. No refunds will be issued for current or future purchases except where required by law or by Meta platform policy.

Intellectual property

Ripping game files, asset theft, or redistribution of game content is a violation of copyright and may result in legal action.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new date at the top.

Contact

Need help or have questions? Contact us at feargorilladev@gmail.com.
